title: Compromise of tj-actions/changed-files
confirmed_facts: GitHub's reviewed advisory describes version tags being repointed to a malicious commit during March 14-15, 2025.
The malicious action extracted runner-process secrets and emitted them into workflow logs.
GitHub lists versions through 45.0.7 as affected and 46.0.1 as patched.
inferences: Immutable references reduce tag-retargeting risk but do not replace action source review, token minimization, egress control, or credential rotation.
trust_boundaries: runner to workflow logs and network
control_hypotheses: CI checks should distinguish immutable commit pins from tags and branches.
A compromised build step should encounter minimal credentials and observable, bounded egress.
Rotation evidence is required after suspected runner-memory or log exposure.

regression.mutation: Replace an action commit SHA with a mutable tag and require CICD-ACTION-001 to fail.
